page.layout: One page of text with margin notes on the right. Running text with numbered items 3, 4 and 5, a rule, a centred heading, and a paragraph with a drop cap. Two marginal notes stand in the right margin beside that paragraph. Page number at top right.

main_text.p: ʃ[?] Observet rationem temporis, quod est universale, & particulare. Universale est: 1. Annuum. Hic ver & autumnus sunt tempora peregrinationi maximè opportuna. 2.Menstruum. Ratio no-vilunii & plenilunii habenda. Particulare, est dies, vel nox. Utriusq; observanda est, partim quantitas, partim qualitas. Summa doctrinæ de peregrinatione est: Meta peregrinationis est cognitio; cognitionis, actio; actionis, Gloria ejus, qui universam umbratilem hanc vitam voluit esse pere-grinationem ad verè vitalem vitam: & Patriæ, quæ emittit liberos, ut receptis utatur mo-[?]ribus, emolumentum.
main_text.head: PEROR ATIO CANONICÆ.

p.i: ATque hæc est illa Canonica, quâ ostendere pro vi-Peroratio Canonicæ.rili conati sumus rationem studiorum perfectam & unicam, ipsa natura quam præscribit. PræscribitUtilitas Canonicæ. enim ut in quaq; actione præno scamus finem, impedi-menta femoveamus, remedia & media admoveamus. Sed præterquam quòd hic veluti in tabella quilibet contuetur studiorum rectè instituendorum rationem, etiam id utilitatis ex hac descriptione redit ad studio-sos, ut condiscant, quomodo cujusq; disciplinæ Cano-nicam formare, quomodo Metaphysicæ, quomodo Physicæ operam dare debeant. Nunc obsigno hanc Canonicam, & typo methodico, itemq; piâ coronide ob-signo.

page.notes: The numeral at item 5 is printed as a long, hooked character (ʃ) and is transcribed as seen. The hyphenated "mo-" at the line end of the last full paragraph is partly obscured by a stain, so "ribus" is read with some doubt. The "M" of "Metaphysicæ" is a decorated letter and is transcribed as an ordinary M. The paragraph beginning "ATque" is set in italic throughout, so the whole of it is marked in italic.
